title: Creating DataLoaders for Our ViT Feature Extractor Model

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: How did you go?
cues.zh: 做得如何？

cues.en: Did you manage to create some data loaders for the feature extractor?
cues.zh: 有成功替 ViT 特徵擷取器建立 DataLoader 嗎？

cues.en: I trust you gave it a shot.
cues.zh: 相信你有試過。

cues.en: But let's now do it together.
cues.zh: 現在一起來。

cues.en: This one will be quite a swift little video.
cues.zh: 這段影片會很快。

cues.en: So we want to set up the data loaders.
cues.zh: 我們要設定 DataLoader。

cues.en: What's the main thing we want to pay attention to here?
cues.zh: 這裡最需要注意什麼？

cues.en: Well, the data transforms, of course.
cues.zh: 當然是資料轉換。

cues.en: So when we're loading in data to be used with, we're loading in our pre-trained or sorry, we're loading in our custom data pizza, steak, sushi, 20% test and train.
cues.zh: 載入資料時，載入預訓練，不對，是載入自訂資料，也就是披薩、牛排、壽司 20% 的測試集與訓練集。

cues.en: We want to turn those data sets into data loaders.
cues.zh: 我們要把這些資料集轉成 DataLoader。

cues.en: What is the main thing when we're loading data for a pre-trained model?
cues.zh: 替預訓練模型載入資料時，最重要的是什麼？

cues.en: Well, we want to make sure that it's in the same format.
cues.zh: 要確保格式相同。

cues.en: So we're going to create train data load of it, test data load of it.
cues.zh: 所以建立 train_dataloader_vit 和 test_dataloader_vit。

cues.en: We want to make sure that it's in the same format that our PRE-TRAINED model has been trained on.
cues.zh: 必須確保格式與預訓練模型原先訓練的資料相同。

cues.en: So let's go data set up DOT, create data loaders.
cues.zh: 呼叫 data_setup.create_dataloaders。

cues.en: Again, this is using our pre-made function from the going modular section, so that's saving us a fair bit of code here and we can just pass in the training directory, the testing directory, the transform
cues.zh: 一樣使用模組化章節預先寫好的函式，省下不少程式碼；只需要傳入訓練目錄、測試目錄，以及轉換

cues.en: that we want to transform our data with, which will be of course vet transform.
cues.zh: 資料所需的操作，當然就是 vit_transforms。

cues.en: So let's pass that in there.
cues.zh: 把它傳進去。

cues.en: It transforms.
cues.zh: vit_transforms。

cues.en: Then what else do we want?
cues.zh: 還需要什麼？

cues.en: Well, we'll just give it a batch size of 32.
cues.zh: 把 batch_size 設為 32。

cues.en: Hey, our trusty old 32.
cues.zh: 又是可靠的老朋友 32。

cues.en: And of course you can experiment with these different values, but let's now get a little look see of what's going on here.
cues.zh: 當然，可以實驗不同的數值，不過現在先看看結果。

cues.en: We'll get the length of our training data loader, see how many batches of testing and training data we have, and just make sure we've got the class names.
cues.zh: 取得訓練 DataLoader 的長度，看看訓練與測試各有多少批次，也確認有取得類別名稱。

cues.en: Boom, look at that exact same output as our Ethernet B2 data loaders.
cues.zh: 看，輸出與 EfficientNet-B2 的 DataLoader 完全相同。

cues.en: But the key difference is that we're transforming the data that we've loaded into these data loaders using the zip transforms rather than the F net B two transforms.
cues.zh: 但關鍵差別是，這些 DataLoader 載入的資料使用 vit_transforms 轉換，而不是 effnetb2_transforms。

cues.en: So if we go in here, of course this functionality comes from data set up-I create data loaders, there's that function there.
cues.zh: 進去看看，這個功能當然來自 data_setup.py 的 create_dataloaders 函式，就在這裡。

cues.en: So that's all we need to do for that section.
cues.zh: 這一部分只需要做這些。

cues.en: I feel like we are up to training time, so let's go into training of it.
cues.zh: 我想該訓練了，接下來訓練 ViT

cues.en: Feature Extractor.
cues.zh: 特徵擷取器。

cues.en: And again, I've got another challenge for you and that's to jump ahead of the video, see if you can go all the way to getting some loss curves for our model.
cues.zh: 再給你一個挑戰，試著在看影片之前先完成，看看能不能一路做到產生模型的損失曲線。

cues.en: But we'll do that together in the next video.
cues.zh: 不過，下一段影片我們也會一起做。

cues.en: I'll see you there.
cues.zh: 到時見。
